y-m-41-01.title: Shin ana iya amfani da ƙa'idar 'idan samfur 0 ne, fa'ida ɗaya shine 0' don matrices kuma?
y-m-41-01.topic: Lokacin da samfurin matrices biyu waɗanda ba sifili matrices ya zama sifili matrix
y-m-41-01.goal: Yi hukunci tare da misalan ko ƙa'idar 'idan samfur 0 ne, dalili ɗaya shine 0', wanda ke riƙe don lambobi, kuma yana riƙe da matrices, kuma la'akari da yadda ƙarshen ya canza lokacin da kuka canza zuwa matrix daban.
y-m-41-01.material: Domin lambobi na gaske a, b, idan ab=0 to a=0 ko b=0. Jian ya yi tunanin za a iya amfani da wannan doka don matrices kuma ya ce wannan: "Idan AB = O da A ba matrix ba ne, to B shine matrix sifili." Anan O shine matrix sifili na 2 × 2 tare da duk shigarwar 0. A shine matrix 2 × 2 wanda layin farko shine (1, 2) sai layi na biyu shine (2, 4), B shine matrix 2 × 2 wanda layin farko shine (p, q) sai jere na biyu (r, s). Duk abubuwan shiga lamba ne.
y-m-41-01.thinking.0: Yi hukunci ko ana iya ɗaukar ka'idar lambobi zuwa matrices kamar yadda yake
y-m-41-01.thinking.1: Yi misalan misali wanda ya gamsar da yanayin kai tsaye
y-m-41-01.thinking.2: Faɗa matrices inda misalan misalan ya taso kuma a gwada inda baya
y-m-41-01.prereq.0: Alamar H1 matsala ce kawai da matakin tallafi don wannan aikin samarwa, ba ƙima da tsarin karatun ya saita ba. Yana ɗaukar ɗaliban da suka riga sun yi karatun matrices a matakin gabatarwa na sakandare.
y-m-41-01.prereq.1: Kuna iya lissafin samfurin matrices 2 × 2 ta amfani da shigarwar
y-m-41-01.prereq.2: Sanin ma'anar matrix juzu'i (matrix wanda ke ba da matrix E idan aka ninka)
y-m-41-01.s.s1.prompt: Kuna son gano ko da'awar Jian tayi daidai. Menene matakin farko mafi dacewa?
y-m-41-01.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta a cikin jumla wane nau'in B kuke buƙatar samun ɗaya kawai don karya da'awar.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta shigarwa ɗaya na AB ta amfani da p, q, r, s, kuma nemo akwati guda inda ya zama 0.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.o.a: Tun da A ba matrix na sifili bane, yarda cewa B sifili ne matrix, kamar yadda yake tare da lambobi
y-m-41-01.s.s1.r.a: Kun ɗauki ƙa'idar da aka yi amfani da ita don lambobi zuwa matrix kamar yadda take. Rubuta kai tsaye abin da dole ne a riƙe don jimlar samfuran shigarwar don samfurin ya zama O.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.o.b: Ba za ku iya yanke hukunci ba kafin sanin duk shigarwar B
y-m-41-01.s.s1.r.b: Ko da ba tare da yanke shawarar B ba, kuna iya yin hukunci idan akwai B guda ɗaya kawai wanda ya karya da'awar. Ka tuna yadda ake gwada 'da'awar game da duk B'.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.o.c: Gwada ko, a cikin B waɗanda ba sifili matrices ba, akwai wanda ke da AB=O
y-m-41-01.s.s1.r.c: Kun ga cewa da'awar game da 'duk B' ce kuma saita alƙawarin ku zuwa nemo misalin da ya dace da yanayin.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.o.d: Tunda shigarwar A ba su da lambobi mara kyau, abubuwan shigarwar AB ba za su iya zama 0 ba
y-m-41-01.s.s1.r.d: Ko da A ba shi da lambobi mara kyau, idan shigarwar B ba su da kyau, jimlar samfuran na iya zama 0. Yi tunani sosai game da yuwuwar ƙimar B.
y-m-41-01.s.s1.explain: Da'awar cewa 'yana riƙe da duk B' ya karye ta hanyar B guda ɗaya wanda ya gamsar da yanayin yayin da ƙarshe ba daidai ba ne. Don haka ganowa da gwada B wanda ba matrix na sifili ba tare da AB=O shine matakin farko da ya dace.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.prompt: Yi biyu daban-daban B waɗanda ba sifili matrices tare da AB=O. Abubuwan shigarwa p, q, r, s su ne lamba daga -9 zuwa 9.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta abubuwan shiga guda huɗu na AB kai tsaye ta amfani da p, q, r, s, kuma rubuta abin da ake buƙata don duka su zama 0.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ko yanayin iri ɗaya ya sake maimaitawa a cikin dabarar da kuka rubuta.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.ok.c2: B ba matrix ɗin sifili ba ne.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.fail.c2: B matrix ɗin sifili ne. Aƙalla wani shigarwa dole bai zama 0 ba.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.ok.c3: Shigarwa a layi na 1, shafi na 1 na AB ita ce 0.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.fail.c3: Shigarwa a layi na 1, shafi na 1 na AB (1×p+2×r) ba 0 ba ce.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.ok.c4: Shigarwa a layi na 1, shafi na 2 na AB ita ce 0.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.fail.c4: Shigarwa a layi na 1, shafi na 2 na AB (1×q+2×s) ba 0 ba ce.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.explain: Layi na farko na AB shi ne (p+2r, q+2s), na biyu kuma (2p+4r, 2q+4s). Layi na biyu ninkin 2 ne na na farko, saboda haka idan p+2r=0 da q+2s=0, AB=O. Misali, idan layi na farko na B shi ne (2, 0), na biyu kuma (−1, 0), A da B ba matrix ɗin sifili ba ne amma AB=O.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.prompt: Zaɓi B ɗaya da ka samu, nuna cewa dukkan shigarwar AB 0 ne, sannan ka rubuta abin da ka koya game da da’awar Jian.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.hint.0: Idan ka lissafta shigarwar layi na 1, shafi na 1 da na 2 na AB kawai, duba abin da ya faru da sauran shigarwa. (ƙimomin asali: 1)
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.hint.1: Yi amfani da maganganun A ba matrix sifili ba ne da B ba matrix sifili ba ne, ka kammala da jumla guda.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Da B ɗin da ka zaɓa, shin ka lissafta kuma ka nuna cewa duk shigarwar AB guda 4 0 ne?
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana a sarari cewa A da B duka ba matrix sifili ba ne?
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Shin ka rubuta bisa sanin cewa misali guda ya isa ya karya da’awar da ta shafi duk B?
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan layi na farko na B shi ne (2, 0), na biyu kuma (−1, 0), duk shigarwar AB 0 ne, saboda haka AB=O. A da B ba matrix sifili ba ne amma ninkarsu matrix sifili ce, don haka dokar lambobi cewa idan ninkar 0 ce, ɗaya daga cikin masu ninkawa 0 ne, ba ta aiki ga matrices.
y-m-41-01.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan aka sa p=0, q=2, r=0, s=−1, AB matrix sifili ce mai duk shigarwa 0. Ninkar na iya zama matrix sifili ko da duka ba sifili ba ne, saboda haka maganar Jian ba daidai ba ce.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.prompt: Jian ya sake cewa: “Dalili shi ne layuka biyu na A ninkar juna ne.” Idan aka yi amfani da A′ (layi na farko (1, 2), na biyu (3, 4)) maimakon A, shin A′B=O zai iya faruwa ga B marar sifili? (A′ yana da inverse matrix, domin 1×4−2×3=−2 ba 0 ba ne.)
y-m-41-01.s.s3.hint.0: Rubuta abin da zai canza idan aka ninka ɓangarorin biyu na A′B=O da matrix mai alaƙa da A′.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta yadda bambancin A da A′ (samun inverse matrix ko a’a) yake shafar nemo B da AB=O.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.o.a: Ba zai faru ba. Ninka ɓangarorin biyu na A′B=O da inverse na A′ yana ba da B=O.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.r.a: Ka yi hukunci game da yanayin da aka canza sharadinsa ta amfani da sabon sifar A′, wato tana da inverse matrix.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.o.b: Zai iya faruwa. Ninkar matrices biyu marasa sifili na iya zama O a kowane hali.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.r.b: Ka faɗaɗa ƙarshe daga misalin baya zuwa duk A. Sake duba sifar A da aka yi amfani da ita a misalin.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.o.c: Na gwada wasu B, babu wanda ya ba da O, saboda haka ba zai faru ba.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.r.c: Gwaji da dama na ƙarfafa tabbaci, amma ba ya bincika duk B. Yi tunanin ko akwai hanyar tunani kan duk B lokaci guda.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.o.d: Zai iya faruwa. Shigarwar A′ sun fi na A girma, saboda haka ninkar na da damar zama 0.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.r.d: Girman shigarwa ba ma’aunin yanke hukunci ba ne. Yi tunanin yadda samun inverse matrix yake haɗuwa da A′B=O.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.explain: Idan A′ yana da inverse matrix, ninka ɓangarorin A′B=O da wannan inverse don samun B=O. Saboda haka B marar sifili ba zai iya cika A′B=O ba. A na baya ba shi da inverse matrix, don haka ba a iya samun wannan ƙarshe.
y-m-41-01.s.s3.acc.0: Gwada B da dama don ƙarfafa tabbaci matakin farko ne mai ma’ana. Amma ba za ka iya gwada kowane B ba, saboda haka tunani kan duk B ta amfani da sifar inverse matrix ya fi tabbaci.

y-m-41-07.title: Idan aka ɗauki murabba’in kowace ƙididdiga, shin za a samu murabba’in matrix?
y-m-41-07.topic: Nemo yanayin da kuskuren fahimtar murabba’in matrix ta ɗaukar murabba’in ƙididdiga yake aiki
y-m-41-07.goal: Nemo matrix ɗin da kuskuren “murabba’in matrix shi ne murabba’in kowace ƙididdiga” yake aiki a kansu, gano sharadin, sannan tantance cewa wannan kewayon ba ya wucewa ga ƙarfin gaba ɗaya.
y-m-41-07.material: Minseo ta ce, “Murabba’in matrix A daidai yake da matrix da aka ɗauki murabba’in kowace ƙididdiga daban.” A matrix 2×2 mai layin farko (a, b) da na biyu (c, d), a kira matrix mai ƙididdigogi murabba’i daban A* (layin farko (a², b²), na biyu (c², d²), karanta “a murabba’i”). A² shi ne ninkin matrix A×A. Misali, idan layin farko na A (1, 2) ne kuma na biyu (3, 4), A² yana da layi na farko (7, 10), na biyu (15, 22); A* kuma yana da layi na farko (1, 4), na biyu (9, 16). Duk ƙididdigogi lambobi cikakku ne.
y-m-41-07.thinking.0: Nemo yanayin da kuskuren fahimtar ya yi aiki ta amfani da haruffa
y-m-41-07.thinking.2: Bincika ko wata sifa da ta yi aiki sau ɗaya tana aiki ga ƙarfin na gaba
y-m-41-07.s.s1.prompt: A misalin sama, A² da A* sun bambanta. To wane mataki na farko ne ya fi dacewa don gano ko akwai matrix mai A²=A*?
y-m-41-07.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta ƙididdigar layi 1, shafi 1 na A² kai tsaye ta amfani da a, b, c, sannan ka kwatanta da ƙididdigar matsayi ɗaya na A*.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta ɗaya bayan ɗaya sharadin da ake buƙata domin a samu dabara iri ɗaya a duk wurare huɗu.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.o.a: Tunda sun bambanta a misalin, yanke cewa babu matrix da A²=A*.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.r.a: Bambanta ga matrix guda ba yana nufin bambanci ga duk matrix ba. Yi tunani yadda za a nemo ko akwai matrix da suke daidai.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.o.b: Rubuta ƙididdigogi huɗu na A² da haruffa sannan ka kwatanta da ƙididdigogi A* a wurare iri ɗaya.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.r.b: Ka kafa sharadin da dabara mai haruffa da za ta iya ɗaukar duk yanayi, ba misali guda kawai ba.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.o.c: Ka yanke tun farko cewa yana aiki ne ga matrix diagonal kawai (b da c duk 0), sannan ka gwada wannan kaɗai.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.r.c: Ka takaita kewayon tun farko. Ka buɗe yiwuwar akwai matrix marasa diagonal ma da suke daidai, ka gwada.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.o.d: Saka lambobi daban-daban cikin A, nemo yanayin da A² da A* suke daidai.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.r.d: Gwada lambobi daban-daban hanya ce mai kyau ta bincike ma. Bayan ka samo ɗaya, bincika da haruffa dalilin sharadin.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.explain: Idan aka rubuta ƙididdigogi huɗu na A² da haruffa, layi na farko (a²+bc, ab+bd), layi na biyu (ca+dc, cb+d²) ake samu. Idan aka kwatanta da A* a wurare iri ɗaya, sharuddan su ne bc=0, b(a+d)=b², c(a+d)=c². Bincike ta saka lambobi ma yana da kyau, amma dabara mai haruffa tana nuna duk yanayi lokaci guda.
y-m-41-07.s.s1.acc.0: Bincike ta saka lambobi daban-daban farawa ce mai ma’ana. Amma dole a bincika da dabara mai haruffa dalilin da ya sa misalin da ka samo yake aiki.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri A daban-daban guda 3 masu A²=A* waɗanda ba matrix diagonal ba (aƙalla ɗaya daga b da c ba 0 ba). Ƙididdigogin a, b, c, d lambobi cikakku ne daga −9 zuwa 9.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta ƙididdigogi huɗu na A² da na A* da haruffa, sannan rubuta ma’aunai da ke daidaita wurare masu kama.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.hint.1: Don bc ya zama 0, sa ɗaya daga b da c ya zama 0, sannan nemo ƙimomin da ke cika sauran ma’aunai.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.ok.c2: Layi 1, shafi 1 da layi 2, shafi 2 na A² sun yi daidai da a² da d².
y-m-41-07.s.s2.fail.c2: Layi 1, shafi 1 na A² (a²+bc) bai yi daidai da a² ba.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.ok.c3: Layi 1, shafi 2 na A² ya yi daidai da b².
y-m-41-07.s.s2.fail.c3: Layi 1, shafi 2 na A² (ab+bd) bai yi daidai da b² ba.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.ok.c4: Layi 2, shafi 1 na A² ya yi daidai da c².
y-m-41-07.s.s2.fail.c4: Layi 2, shafi 1 na A² (ca+dc) bai yi daidai da c² ba.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.fail.c5: Matrix diagonal ne inda b da c duk 0. Dole ne ka nemo misali marar diagonal.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.explain: Sharuddan su ne bc=0, b(a+d)=b², c(a+d)=c². Idan b≠0, to c=0 kuma dole a+d=b; idan c≠0, to b=0 kuma dole a+d=c. Misali, idan layin farko (1, 3) ne na biyu (0, 2), A² yana da layi na farko (1, 9), na biyu (0, 4), A* kuma iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.prompt: Da ɗaya daga A da ka samo, ƙididdige ƙididdiga guda ta A² kai tsaye ka nuna ta yi daidai da ƙididdigar wurin ɗaya a A*, sannan rubuta yadda ka nemo A irin wannan.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.hint.0: Saka ƙididdigogin A da ka zaɓa cikin layi 1, shafi 2 na A² (ko wani wuri), rubuta a matsayin ninkin da jimilla, sannan ka kwatanta da wuri ɗaya a A*.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.hint.1: Duba ko ka maimaita ƙa’ida ɗaya (wace shigarwa ka sa 0) yayin ƙirƙirar A da dama.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Da A da ka zaɓa, lissafta shigarwa ɗaya na A² ta ninkawa da tarawa.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Kwatanta ƙimar da shigarwar A* a wuri ɗaya.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.selfAssess.2: Bayyana yadda ka nema, misali sa b ko c=0 ko daidaita a+d.
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.model.0: Idan layukan A su ne (1, 3) da (0, 2), shigarwar A² a layi 1 shafi 2 ita ce 1×3+3×2=9, ta A* kuma 3²=9. Na sa c=0 kuma na sa a+d=b. (ƙimomin asali: 1, 2)
y-m-41-07.s.s2.because.model.1: Idan layukan A su ne (4, 0) da (5, 1), shigarwar A² a layi 2 shafi 1 ita ce 5×4+1×5=25, ta A* kuma 5²=25. Na sa b=0 kuma na sa a+d=c. (ƙimomin asali: 2, 1)
y-m-41-07.s.s3.prompt: Duba A mai layuka (1, 3) da (0, 2). A² tana da layuka (1, 9) da (0, 4), daidai da A*. Shin A³ (=A²×A) da matrix mai shigarwa-zuwa-shigarwa kub (layi 1 shafi 2 ita ce 3³=27) ma daidai suke? Lissafta A³ a wannan wuri kai tsaye. (ƙimomin asali: 1, 2)
y-m-41-07.s.s3.hint.0: Ta amfani da A³=A²×A, rubuta jimillar ninkar biyu da ke ba da shigarwar A³ layi 1 shafi 2.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.hint.1: Kwatanta ƙimar da ka samu da kub na 3; idan ko wuri guda ya bambanta, matrices ba daidai suke ba.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.o.a: Shigarwar A³ layi 1 shafi 2 ita ce 27. Saboda haka A³ ma daidai yake da matrix mai kub na kowace shigarwa.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.r.a: 27 kub na 3 ne, ba shigarwar A³ ba. Lissafta shigarwar A³ bisa ma’anar ninkar matrix. (ƙimomin asali: 1, 2)
y-m-41-07.s.s3.o.b: Shigarwar A³ layi 1 shafi 2 ita ce 21. Sauran shigarwar daidai ne, don haka A³ daidai yake da kub na kowace shigarwa.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.r.b: Domin matrices su yi daidai, shigarwar dukkan wurare dole su yi daidai. Ko guda ɗaya ya bambanta, ba matrix ɗaya ba ne.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.o.c: Shigarwar A³ layi 1 shafi 2 ita ce 18. Saboda haka A³ ya bambanta da kub na kowace shigarwa.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.r.c: Ƙarshe ɗaya ne, amma lissafin 18 ya rasa wasu sharuɗɗa. Duba ko ka ƙara ninkar A² layi 1 shafi 1 da A layi 1 shafi 2.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.o.d: Shigarwar A³ layi 1 shafi 2 ita ce 21. Saboda haka A³ ya bambanta da kub na kowace shigarwa.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.r.d: Ka yi lissafi kai tsaye don duba ko sifar da ta yi aiki ga A² tana aiki ga A³ ma.
y-m-41-07.s.s3.explain: A³=A²×A, shigarwar layi 1 shafi 2 ita ce 1×3+9×2=21. Kub na shigarwar ita ce 3³=27, saboda haka matrices sun bambanta. Ko A²=A* ya yi aiki, ba lallai A³ ta yi aiki ba; kada ka ɗauka sifar za ta ci gaba domin ta yi aiki sau ɗaya. (ƙimomin asali: 1, 2)

y-m-41-09.title: Idan shigarwa 0 ce, babu inverse matrix?
y-m-41-09.topic: Sharadin samun inverse ga matrix 2×2 da dangantakarsa da kasancewar shigarwa 0.
y-m-41-09.goal: Gwada da’awoyin abokai biyu masu saɓani da misalan ƙaryatawa; koyi cewa shigarwa 0 ko rashin sa ba ya ƙayyade samuwar inverse, sannan ƙirƙiri matrix marar inverse.
y-m-41-09.material: Bari layukan matrix M na 2×2 su zama (a, b) da (c, d). Sharadin wajibi kuma isasshe don M ta sami inverse shi ne ad−bc ba 0 ba (a nan ana amfani da sharadin ba tare da tabbatarwa ba). a, b, c, d lambobi cikakku ne. Soyun ta ce: “Idan ko shigarwa guda 0 ce, babu inverse.” Dohyeon ya ce: “Idan babu shigarwa 0, akwai inverse.”
y-m-41-09.thinking.0: Gwada maganganun abokan ta ƙirƙirar misalan ƙaryatawa.
y-m-41-09.thinking.1: Bambanta kamannin shigarwa da samuwar inverse matrix.
y-m-41-09.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misalai dabam-dabam da suka cika sharadi.
y-m-41-09.prereq.1: Ka riga ka koyi sharadin samun inverse ga matrix 2×2 (an bayar da shi a bayanin aikin nan).
y-m-41-09.prereq.2: Ka iya ambaton shigarwar matrix 2×2 bisa matsayi (layi 1 shafi 2, da sauransu).
y-m-41-09.s.s1.prompt: Yaya za ka tantance maganganun abokan biyu? Zaɓi ra’ayinka kafin ƙirƙirar misalai da gwadawa.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.hint.0: Rubuta irin matrix ɗin da dole ta kasance domin maganar Soyun ta zama kuskure.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.hint.1: Daga matrices mafi sauƙi, misali masu shigarwa 0 da 1 kawai, lissafta ad−bc.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.o.a: Maganar Soyun kaɗai ce daidai. Idan akwai 0, ad ko bc zai zama 0, saboda haka ad−bc ma 0 ne.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.r.a: Ko ninkar ɗaya ta zama 0, idan ɗayar ba 0 ba ce, ad−bc na iya zama ba 0 ba. Gwada bambancin ninkar biyun.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.o.b: Maganar Dohyeon kaɗai ce daidai. Idan babu shigarwa 0, ad da bc duka ba 0 ba ne, saboda haka ad−bc ma ba 0 ba ne.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.r.b: Ko ad da bc duka ba 0 ba ne, idan ƙimarsu ɗaya ce bambancinsu 0 ne. Gwada ko ninkar biyun za su iya zama daidai.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.o.c: Duka maganganun daidai ne. Samuwar inverse tana danganta da ko akwai 0 cikin shigarwa.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.r.c: Samuwar inverse tana dogara ne da ƙimar ad−bc. Yi amfani da ita a matsayin ma’auni, ba kamannin shigarwa ba.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.o.d: Dukansu ba daidai ba ne. Akwai misalin da ke ƙaryata kowace magana.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.r.d: Ka zaɓi hanyar gwada ko akwai misalin ƙaryatawa ga kowace da’awa dabam.
y-m-41-09.s.s1.explain: Maganar Soyun ba daidai ba ce idan akwai matrix mai shigarwa 0 kuma mai inverse; ta Dohyeon kuma ba daidai ba ce idan akwai matrix mai duk shigarwa marasa 0 amma marar inverse. Duka misalan ƙaryatawa suna nan, saboda haka maganganun biyu ba daidai ba ne.
y-m-41-09.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri matrices biyu dabam da ke ƙaryata maganar Soyun, wato masu shigarwa 0 amma masu inverse. a, b, c, d lambobi cikakku ne daga −9 zuwa 9.
y-m-41-09.s.s2.hint.0: Sa shigarwa guda 0, sauran kuma marasa 0, ka lissafta ad−bc.
y-m-41-09.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ad−bc ya zama 0, canza wurin sifilin ko sauran shigarwa. (ƙimomin asali: 0)
y-m-41-09.s.s2.fail.c2: Babu shigarwa ko ɗaya da ya zama 0.
y-m-41-09.s.s2.ok.c3: ad−bc ba 0 ba ne, saboda haka matrix tana da inverse.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.fail.c3: ad−bc ba 0 ba ne, saboda haka matrix tana da inverse.
y-m-41-09.s.s2.fail.c3: ad−bc 0 ne, saboda haka matrix ba ta da inverse.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.ok.c3: ad−bc 0 ne, saboda haka matrix ba ta da inverse.
y-m-41-09.s.s2.explain: Misali, layi na farko (2, 3), na biyu (0, 5) yana da shigarwa 0 amma ad−bc=10, don haka yana da inverse. Ma’auni ba kasancewar 0 ba ce, sai ko bambancin ad da bc ya zama 0. Matrix (0, 0, 1, 1) mai shigarwa 0 kuma marar inverse misali ne da ke goyon bayan maganar Soyun, ba misalin ƙaryatawa ba.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.prompt: Ƙirƙiri matrices biyu dabam da ke ƙaryata maganar Dohyeon, wato masu dukkan shigarwa marasa 0 kuma marasa inverse. a, b, c, d lambobi cikakku ne daga −9 zuwa 9.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko rubuta dangantakar ad da bc da ake buƙata domin ad−bc ya zama 0.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.hint.1: Lissafta ad−bc da lambobi huɗun da ka zaɓa ka duba ko 0 ne; idan ba haka ba, canza shigarwa guda.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.ok.c2: Ba dukkan shigarwar ne marasa 0 ba.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.explain: Misali, layuka (1, 2) da (2, 4) suna da shigarwa marasa 0, amma ad−bc=4−4=0, don haka ba su da inverse. Idan layi na biyu ninkin layi na farko ne, ad=bc kullum.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.because.prompt: A jumla 1 ko 2 bayyana yadda ka samo misalin ƙaryatawa na biyu, matrix mai dukkan shigarwa marasa 0 kuma marar inverse.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.because.hint.0: A matrix ɗin da ka ƙirƙira, lissafta ad da bc kowanne, ka rubuta ƙimomin gefe da gefe.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.because.hint.1: Haɗa shigarwar layi na biyu da ta farko, ka raba su, ka duba ko akwai ƙa’ida iri ɗaya.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.because.selfAssess.0: Shin ka bayyana yadda za a sa ad da bc su yi daidai, misali sa layi na biyu ninkin layi na farko?
y-m-41-09.s.s3.because.selfAssess.1: Shin ka shigar da lambobin matrix ɗin ka lissafta ad da bc da gaske?
y-m-41-09.s.s3.because.selfAssess.2: Shin ka faɗi cewa ana iya samar da wasu misalai ta wannan hanya ma?
y-m-41-09.s.s3.because.model.0: Na mayar da layi na biyu ninkin 2 na layi na farko. Sai ad da bc suka yi daidai, saboda haka ad−bc=0.
y-m-41-09.s.s3.because.model.1: Domin a×d da b×c su yi daidai, na zaɓi nau’i-nau’i masu ninkar iri ɗaya kamar 1×4 da 2×2, sannan na ɗauki (1, 2, 2, 4).

y-m-41-02.title: Warwarewar “AB=AC, don haka B=C”: a ina aka yi kuskure?
y-m-41-02.topic: Sharuɗɗan da ke ba da damar yanke B=C daga AB=AC
y-m-41-02.goal: Nemo layin warwarewar matrix da ya yi amfani da sifar lambobi ba tare da hujja ba, gano sharadin da zai sa ƙarshe daidai, sannan ka ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa idan wannan sharadin babu.
y-m-41-02.material: A, B, C duk matrices 2×2 ne, O kuma matrix sifili ce mai dukkan shigarwa 0. Jiho ya warware kamar haka, ya yanke “Idan AB=AC, to B=C.”
y-m-41-02.thinking.0: Duba sifar da kowace layi na warwarewar ta dogara da ita.
y-m-41-02.thinking.1: Nemo sharadin da ake buƙata domin ƙarshe ya yi aiki.
y-m-41-02.thinking.2: Ƙirƙiri misalin ƙaryatawa idan sharadin babu.
y-m-41-02.prereq.1: Ana iya duba tarawa, ninkawa da dokar rarrabawa ta matrices 2×2 ta amfani da shigarwa.
y-m-41-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layin warwarewar Jiho da hujjarsa ba daidai ba ce.
y-m-41-02.s.s1.hint.0: Kusa da kowace layi, rubuta sifar da aka yi amfani da ita wajen samo layin daga na baya.
y-m-41-02.s.s1.hint.1: Ga layin da hujja ta yi wuya, saka matrix 2×2 takamaimai ka gwada ko sakamakon haka yake.
y-m-41-02.s.s1.line.1: Cire AC daga ɓangarorin biyu yana ba AB−AC=O.
y-m-41-02.s.s1.line.2: Fitar da factor ta dokar rarrabawa yana ba A(B−C)=O.
y-m-41-02.s.s1.line.3: A ba matrix sifili ba ne, saboda haka raba ɓangarorin biyu da A yana ba B−C=O.
y-m-41-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 4 ne. Har zuwa na 3, ma’aunai sun fito ne daga daidaito da dokar rarrabawa. Amma a layi na 4 an “raba” da A saboda kawai A ba matrix sifili ba ne. Ga matrices, ko A ba sifili ba ne, yana yiwuwa A(B−C)=O alhali B−C ba matrix sifili ba ne. Misali, idan layuka biyu na A duka (1, 1) ne, layi na farko na B−C kuma (1, −1), na biyu (−1, 1), to A(B−C)=O.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.prompt: Domin ƙarshe B=C na Jiho ya zama daidai, menene ya kamata a sani game da A domin gyara hujjar layi na 4?
y-m-41-02.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko faɗi wace sifar ce ke ba da hujjar layi na 4 a ninkar lambobi.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.hint.1: Saka sharadin kowace zaɓi cikin A mai duk shigarwa 1 (matrix mai layuka iri ɗaya), ka duba ko A ya cika sharadin.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.o.a: Dukkan shigarwar A tabbatattu ne. Babu shigarwar da take 0 ko korau.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.r.a: Ko duk shigarwa tabbatattu ne, ga A mai layuka iri ɗaya (misali duk shigarwa 1), akwai B−C marar sifili da A(B−C)=O.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.o.b: A yana da inverse matrix (akwai matrix da yake ba E idan aka ninka shi da A).
y-m-41-02.s.s2.r.b: Ka gano sharadin da ke ba da damar mayar da “raba” zuwa ninkawa da inverse matrix.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.o.c: A matrix mai siffa daidaito ce. Shigarwar layi 1 shafi 2 da layi 2 shafi 1 daidai suke.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.r.c: Ko matrix mai daidaito ce, misalin A mai duk shigarwa 1 yana faruwa. Gwada yadda siffar daidaito ta shafi soke ninkawa.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.o.d: B da C duka matrices marasa sifili ne.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.r.d: Sharadin B da C ba shi da alaƙa da rabawa da A. Sake duba yadda layin da za a gyara ya shafi A.
y-m-41-02.s.s2.explain: Idan A yana da inverse matrix, ninka ɓangarorin A(B−C)=O da inverse ɗin domin samun B−C=O. Sharadin cewa duk shigarwa tabbatattu ne ko kuma matrix mai daidaito ce ba ya tabbatar da wannan mataki.
y-m-41-02.s.s3.prompt: A ce layuka biyu na A duka (1, 1), layi na farko na B kuma (1, 2), na biyu (3, 4). Ƙirƙiri C guda da ya bambanta da B kuma AB=AC, ka tabbatar da sakamakon lissafin AB da AC.
y-m-41-02.s.s3.hint.0: Da farko lura yadda kowace shigarwar AC take canzawa idan ka canza wasu shigarwar C.
y-m-41-02.s.s3.hint.1: Da farko lissafta shigarwa huɗu na AB, ka nemo C da shigarwar AC ɗinsa suka yi daidai da su.
y-m-41-02.s.s3.placeholder: Misali: Idan layi na farko na C shi ne (…, …), na biyu kuma (…, …), to ...
y-m-41-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin C da ka ƙirƙira ya bambanta da B da gaske?
y-m-41-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka lissafta kowace shigarwar AC kai tsaye, ka kwatanta da AB?
y-m-41-02.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin ka yi tunanin yadda misalin yake nuna dalilin da ya sa rabawa a layi na 4 ba ta halatta?
y-m-41-02.s.s3.model.0: Idan layi na farko na C shi ne (0, 3), na biyu kuma (4, 3), ya bambanta da B. Layi na farko na AC shi ne (0+4, 3+3)=(4, 6), na biyu ma (4, 6); layuka biyu na AB su ma (4, 6), don haka AB=AC amma B≠C.
y-m-41-02.s.s3.model.1: Idan C yana da layi na farko (2, 1), na biyu (2, 5), ya bambanta da B. Amma layuka biyu na AC su ne (2+2, 1+5)=(4, 6), layuka biyu na AB kuma (1+3, 2+4)=(4, 6), saboda haka AB=AC.

y-m-41-03.prereq.0: Alamar H1 matsala ce kawai da matakin tallafi don wannan aikin samarwa, ba ƙima da tsarin karatun ya saita ba. Yana ɗaukar ɗaliban da suka riga sun yi karatun matrices a matakin gabatarwa na sakandare.
y-m-41-03.title: Tsara hanyoyin da ke tsakanin garuruwa biyu domin samun yawan hanyoyi
y-m-41-03.topic: Rubuta hanyar hanya ta hanya ɗaya a matsayin matrix, ka nemo yawan hanyoyin da ke amfani da hanyoyi biyu
y-m-41-03.goal: Fahimci cewa shigarwar ninkar matrices tana nufin yawan hanyoyin da ke amfani da hanyoyi biyu, sannan ƙirƙiri tsare-tsaren hanyoyi daban-daban masu cika sharuɗɗa da yawa lokaci guda.
y-m-41-03.material: Akwai garuruwa X da Y, duk hanyoyi kuma hanya ɗaya ce. A matrix R, shigarwar a a layi na 1 shafi na 1 ita ce yawan hanyoyin madauwari da suka fara X suka koma X; b a layi na 1 shafi na 2 ita ce yawan hanyoyin X zuwa Y; c a layi na 2 shafi na 1 ita ce yawan hanyoyin Y zuwa X; d a layi na 2 shafi na 2 ita ce yawan hanyoyin madauwari daga Y zuwa Y. Kowanne yawan hanya lamba cikakkiya ce daga 0 zuwa 3. Hanya tana bin hanyoyi biyu a jere, kuma idan ko hanya guda ta bambanta, ana ƙirga ta dabam. Ana ƙirga hanyar madauwari da aka bi sau biyu ma.
y-m-41-03.thinking.0: Fassara abin da shigarwar matrix product take ƙirgawa.
y-m-41-03.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri tsari mai cika sharuɗɗa da dama lokaci guda.
y-m-41-03.thinking.2: Kwatanta tsare-tsare dabam-dabam ba tare da nacewa ga amsa guda ba.
y-m-41-03.prereq.1: Za ka iya ninka matrices 2×2 (haɗa shigarwar layi da shafi, ninka, sannan tara).
y-m-41-03.prereq.2: San cewa murabba’in matrix yana nufin ninka matrix ɗin da kanta sau biyu.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.prompt: Shigarwar layi na 1, shafi na 2 na R², murabba’in R, ita ce ab+bd. Me wannan lamba take ƙirgawa?
y-m-41-03.s.s1.hint.0: Da farko rubuta da kalmomi abin da a, b, c, d kowannensu yake ƙirgawa.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta ab da bd kowanne a matsayin “wace hanya ce ke bi bayan wace, daga wane gari zuwa wane gari”.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.o.a: Yawan hanyoyin da suka fara X suka isa Y ta hanya guda kawai.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.r.a: Yawan hanyoyin tafiya daga X zuwa Y ta hanya guda shi ne b, shigarwar layi na 1, shafi na 2 na R. Yi tunanin ma’anar ninka lambobi.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.o.b: Yawan hanyoyin dawowa da suka tashi X zuwa Y sannan suka koma X.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.r.b: A tafiyar dawowa, garin ƙarshe dole X ne. Duba abin da layi na 1, shafi na 2 ke nufi game da farawa da isa.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.o.c: Yawan hanyoyin da suka fara X suka isa ba tare da wucewa ta Y ko sau ɗaya ba.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.r.c: Ɗaya daga cikin ab+bd yana amfani da hanyar madauwari d a Y, kuma isowar ita ce Y. Nemo garin da kowace kalma ke bi ta ciki.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.o.d: Yawan hanyoyin da suka fara X suka isa Y ta hanyoyi biyu.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.r.d: Ka fassara yadda aka haɗa shigarwa a ninkar matrix a matsayin ƙara hanya ta biyu.
y-m-41-03.s.s1.explain: A ab+bd na shigarwar layi na 1, shafi na 2 na R², ab yana ƙirga hanyoyin X→X→Y (hanyar madauwari, sannan X→Y), bd kuma hanyoyin X→Y→Y (X→Y, sannan hanyar madauwari). Yana ƙirga hanyoyin da suka tashi X suka isa Y ta hanyoyi 2 daidai a jere.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri tsare-tsaren hanyoyi 3 dabam-dabam (a, b, c, d) da suka cika waɗannan sharuɗɗa uku: (1) hanyoyin da suka fara X suka isa Y ta hanyoyi 2 daidai su zama 3; (2) hanyoyin da suka fara Y suka isa X ta hanyoyi 2 aƙalla 1; (3) jimillar hanyoyi ba ta wuce 5 ba.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.hint.0: Rubuta adadin hanyoyin sharadi (1) kai tsaye a matsayin furuci na a, b, d, ka bincika nau’i-nau’in ƙimomi da suke ba da 3.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.hint.1: Idan ka samu ɗaya, duba sharuɗɗan (2) da (3); idan bai dace ba, canza a hankali, misali musanya a da d.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.var.b: b (yawan hanyoyin daga X zuwa Y)
y-m-41-03.s.s2.var.c: c (yawan hanyoyin daga Y zuwa X)
y-m-41-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Yawan hanyoyi lambobi cikakku ne daga 0 zuwa 3.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Dole yawan hanyoyi ya zama lambobi cikakku daga 0 zuwa 3.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Akwai hanyoyi 3 daga X zuwa Y ta amfani da hanyoyi biyu.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Hanyoyin daga X zuwa Y ta hanyoyi biyu (ab+bd) ba 3 ba ne.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.ok.c3: Akwai hanyoyi daga Y zuwa X ta hanyoyi biyu.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Babu hanya daga Y zuwa X ta hanyoyi biyu (ca+dc).
y-m-41-03.s.s2.ok.c4: Jimillar hanyoyi ba ta wuce 5 ba.
y-m-41-03.s.s2.explain: (1) ab+bd=b(a+d)=3, don haka (b, a+d)=(1, 3) ko (3, 1). (2) sharadin c(a+d)≥1 ne, (3) kuma a+b+c+d≤5 ne. Tsare-tsare da dama kamar (a, b, c, d)=(1, 1, 1, 2), (0, 1, 1, 3), (3, 1, 1, 0), (2, 1, 1, 1) sun cika sharuɗɗan. (1, 3, 0, 0) ba shi da hanya daga Y zuwa X, (3, 1, 2, 0) kuma yana da hanyoyi 6, don haka ba su yi aiki ba.
y-m-41-03.s.s3.prompt: Zaɓi tsari guda da ka yi, rubuta duk hanyoyin da suka tashi X suka isa Y ta hanyoyi biyu, ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa adadinsu 3 ne.
y-m-41-03.s.s3.hint.0: Raba yanayin bisa hanyar da ta fara daga X, ka jera su.
y-m-41-03.s.s3.hint.1: A kowane yanayi ƙirga yawan hanyoyin da za a bi na biyu, ninka, sannan ka tara.
y-m-41-03.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Shin ka raba hanyoyin da suka fara X kuma ka ƙirga su ba tare da barin ko ɗaya ba, bisa inda hanya ta farko ta nufa?
y-m-41-03.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Shin ka bayyana tushen ninkar (yawan hanyoyi × yawan hanyoyi) da tarawa (haɗa yanayi)?
y-m-41-03.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Shin ka haɗa hanyoyin da suka bi ta hanyar madauwari?
y-m-41-03.s.s3.model.0: Ga (a, b, c, d)=(1, 1, 1, 2), akwai hanya 1×1=1 ta X→X→Y ta madauwari a X. Hanyar X→Y→Y, wato X zuwa Y sannan ta madauwari a Y, tana da 1×2=2, don haka jimillar hanyoyi 3 ce.
y-m-41-03.s.s3.model.1: Ga (0, 1, 1, 3), X ba shi da hanyar madauwari, don haka X→X→Y hanyoyi 0 ne. Hanyoyin X→Y sannan ta ɗaya daga madauwari 3 a Y suna da 1×3=3, jimilla 3 kenan.

y-m-41-04.title: Za a iya gano farashi daga bayanan tallace-tallace na kwana biyu?
y-m-41-04.topic: Tantance ko bayanin ya isa a tsarin ma’auni masu layi da aka rubuta da matrices
y-m-41-04.goal: Koyi cewa a tsarin ma’auni masu layi da aka rubuta da matrices, bayanai biyu ba lallai su tantance farashi guda ba, sannan tsara ƙarin bayanin da zai tantance su.
y-m-41-04.material: Shagon kayan ciye-ciye ya rubuta adadin sayarwa da jimillar kuɗi ta kowace rana. Litinin ya sayar da gimbap 2 da ramyeon kwano 3 a 13000 won, Talata kuma gimbap 4 da ramyeon kwano 6 a 26000 won. y-m-41-05.title: Wace siffa za ta samu idan muka ci gaba da ɗaukar ƙarfin matrix?
y-m-41-05.topic: Siffofin da ke maimaituwa a ƙarfin matrix da kewayon da za a iya faɗaɗa ƙa’ida zuwa gare shi
y-m-41-05.goal: Hasashen ƙa’ida a ƙarfin matrix, gyara hasashe da tabbaci bisa sabbin sakamakon lissafi, sannan tantance ko ƙa’idar da aka samu ga matrix ɗaya za ta iya aiki ga wani matrix.
y-m-41-05.material: A matrix A mai 2×2, layi na farko (0, −1) ne, na biyu kuma (1, 0). E matrix na ainihi ne (layi na farko (1, 0), na biyu (0, 1)), −E kuma matrix ne da aka canja alamun dukkan ƙididdigogi. A² shi ne ninkin A sau biyu (A murabba’i), A³ kuma ninkin A sau uku. Yayin da ake bayyana bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, gyara tunaninka game da siffar da za a samu idan muka ci gaba da ɗaukar ƙarfin.
y-m-41-05.thinking.0: Hasashen sakamako na gaba ta amfani da wanda aka riga aka samu
y-m-41-05.thinking.1: Gyara hukunci da matakin tabbaci bisa sabon bayani
y-m-41-05.thinking.2: Bincika ko ƙa’idar misali ɗaya za a iya faɗaɗa ta ga duk yanayi
y-m-41-05.prereq.1: Za ka iya ninka matrix 2×2 kuma ka san dokar haɗin ninkawa ((AB)C=A(BC)).
y-m-41-05.prereq.2: Sanin matrix na ainihi E da ma’anar ƙarfin A² da A³.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi hasashe a duk lokacin da aka bayyana bayanai. Bayan sabon bayani, za ka iya gyara tunaninka.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.hint.0: Gwada ko za ka iya sake amfani da ƙarfin da ka riga ka samu don nemo ƙarfin gaba.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta A, A², A³, A⁴ a jere a tebur, ka nemo wuraren da siffa ɗaya ta sake bayyana.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.info: Lokacin ƙididdige A², ya zama −E (layi na farko (−1, 0), na biyu (0, −1)), wanda ƙididdigogi a diagonal kaɗai ne.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.ask: Me za su zama A³ da A⁴? Zaɓi hasashen da ya fi dacewa daga bayanin zuwa yanzu.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.after: A³=A²A=(−E)A=−A kuma A⁴=A²A²=(−E)(−E)=E. Idan ka sake amfani da sakamakon da ka riga ka samu, za ka iya hasashe ba tare da ninkawa kai tsaye ba, sannan ka tabbatar da hasashen ta hanyar ninkawa.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Ƙididdigogin suna ƙaruwa, saboda haka ƙididdigogin A⁴ za su fi na A² yawa sosai.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Yadda girman ƙididdigogi ke canjawa ya fito ne daga tsarin ninkin. Yi tunani yadda gaskiyar A²=−E ke shafar ninkawa na gaba.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.o.b: A³=−A kuma A⁴=E. Za ka iya sake amfani da A² da ka riga ka samu.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Ka yi hasashe ba tare da ninkawa kai tsaye ba ta amfani da sakamakon da ka samu.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.o.c: A³ ma −E ne, A⁴ ma −E ne, saboda haka zai ci gaba da zama −E.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Da alama ka yi tunanin tunda A² ya zama −E, na gaba ma ƙima ɗaya ce. Duba abin da ake samu idan an ninka (−E) da A ko (−E).
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.o.d: Ba za a iya cewa komai game da A³ ba sai an ninka kai tsaye.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Duba ko za ka iya amfani da A² da ka riga ka sani. Wataƙila akwai abin da za ka iya sani ba tare da sake ninkawa ba.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.info: Na tabbatar ta hanyar ninkawa kai tsaye. A³ yana da layi na farko (0, 1) da na biyu (−1, 0), A⁴ kuma E ne.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: To, mene ne matrix A²⁰²⁶ (A mai ƙarfin 2026), wato ninkin A sau 2026?
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Domin A⁴=E, yana komawa E a duk lokacin da aka ninka A sau huɗu. Sau 2026 yana da rukuni 506 na huɗu da saura 2, saboda haka A²⁰²⁶=A²=−E. Hakan yana yiwuwa ne domin ana iya haɗa ninkawa bisa dokar haɗin ninkawa.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Ka yi amfani da tsarin komawa E duk bayan sau huɗu, sannan ka ƙirga sauran.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Da alama ka yi tunanin E ne domin 2026 ma’aurata ne. A² ya kasance −E. Ba kowanne ƙarfin ma’aurata ne E ba.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Wataƙila ka yi tunanin haka domin A yana komawa sifarsa ta farko. Da farko bincika bayan ninkawa sau nawa yake komawa E cikin ninkawa 2026.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Ba za a iya tantancewa ba. Dole ne a ninka sau 2026.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Ta amfani da sakamakon A⁴=E, ba sai an ninka sau 2026 ɗaya bayan ɗaya ba. Duba ninkawa nawa ake buƙata kafin tsarin ya maimaitu.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.info: Aboki ya ce, “Idan an ninka matrix 2×2 sau da yawa, daga ƙarshe zai koma E.” Ka ninka wani matrix C (layi na farko (2, 0), na biyu (0, 1)): C² yana da layi na farko (4, 0), na biyu (0, 1), C³ kuma layi na farko (8, 0), na biyu (0, 1).
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yaya za ka tantance furucin abokin?
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.after: Ƙididdigar wurin layi 1, shafi 1 na C tana 2, 4, 8, tana ninkuwa biyu kowane lokaci (sifar 2 bisa ƙarfin n). Idan ƙa’idar ta ci gaba, C ba zai koma E ba. “A yana maimaituwa bayan sau huɗu” gaskiya ce game da A, ba halin duk matrix ba. Yawan amincewa da ƙa’ida ya dogara da hujja (ko an gwada ta kai tsaye).
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: A ya koma E, saboda haka C ma zai zama E idan aka sake ninka shi wasu lokuta.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ka faɗaɗa ƙa’idar matrix ɗaya zuwa wani. Duba yadda ƙididdigar wurin layi 1, shafi 1 na C² da C³ take canjawa.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Komawar A zuwa E sa’a ce, saboda haka ba za a iya yarda da sakamakon A ba ma.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: A⁴=E sakamako ne da aka tabbatar ta ninkawa kai tsaye. Bambanta abin da aka tabbatar ga matrix guda da faɗaɗa ƙa’ida ga duk matrix.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: C ba ya kama da zai koma E, saboda haka yana da wuya a yarda da furucin abokin.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Ba ka yi amfani da ƙa’idar matrix ɗaya ga wani matrix yadda take ba, ka auna ta tare da sabon bayani.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.o.d: C sau uku kawai ka gani, saboda haka ba za ka iya yanke hukunci ba.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: A sakamakon sau ukun, ana ganin canji na yau da kullum inda ƙididdigar layi 1, shafi 1 take ninkuwa biyu. Ka yi tunani abin da za ka iya cewa daga wannan canjin.
y-m-41-05.s.s1.reflect: Yaya tabbacin ka ya canja lokacin da ka san A² kawai, lokacin da ka san har zuwa A⁴, da kuma bayan ganin C? Yaushe za a iya yarda da ƙa’idar maimaituwa, kuma yaushe ake buƙatar ƙarin bincike?
y-m-41-05.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta amsa ga furucin abokin. A jimla ɗaya ko biyu, rubuta yadda ka nemo A²⁰²⁶ da dalilin da ya sa ba za a iya amfani da wannan hanyar ga C yadda take ba.
y-m-41-05.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko rubuta hanyar da ka yi amfani da ita wajen nemo A²⁰²⁶ a jimla ɗaya, sannan ga C rubuta abin da za ka iya gane daga duba C² da C³.
y-m-41-05.s.s2.hint.1: Kwatanta ko yanayin A ko na C ne yake da ƙa’ida ɗaya da ke maimaituwa.
y-m-41-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Na fara daga tabbataccen gaskiyar A⁴=E?
y-m-41-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Na ambaci ragowar ƙirga (abin da ya rage idan an raba 2026 zuwa rukuni na huɗu)?
y-m-41-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Na bayyana bambancin C da A da lambobi (2, 4, 8, da sauransu)?
y-m-41-05.s.s2.model.0: Idan aka ninka A sau huɗu, yana komawa E; saboda haka idan aka raba ninkawa 2026 zuwa rukunin huɗu, biyu sun rage, A²=−E. Ga C, ƙididdigar layi 1, shafi 1 tana ƙaruwa ne kawai yayin ninkawa, ba ta komawa E, saboda haka ba za a yi amfani da wannan hanya ba.
y-m-41-05.s.s2.model.1: Domin A⁴=E, na yi amfani da gaskiyar cewa zagayowar siffa ɗaya tana maimaituwa bayan 4. C yana ci gaba da ƙaruwa kamar 2, 4, 8 kuma ba ya maimaituwa, don haka wannan hanya ba ta aiki.
y-m-41-05.s.s2.model.2: Tunda ragowar raba 2026 da 4 shi ne 2, A²⁰²⁶ daidai yake da A². C yana ƙaruwa kuma ba ya zama E, don haka furucin abokin ba daidai ba ne.

y-m-41-06.title: Abokai biyu da ba su yarda kan matrix kishiyar AB ba
y-m-41-06.topic: Matrix kishiyar ninkin matrix biyu: tsarin ninkin matrix kishiyoyi
y-m-41-06.goal: Kwatanta ƙa’idoji biyu masu yiwuwa da misali guda, bambance abin da misali guda zai iya tabbatarwa da abin da ba zai iya ba, sannan bayyana da haruffa tsarin ninkin matrix kishiyoyi ga matrix na gama-gari.
y-m-41-06.material: A yana da layi na farko (1, 2), na biyu (0, 1); B kuma layi na farko (1, 0), na biyu (3, 1). Dukansu suna da matrix kishiya. Matrix kishiyar A tana da layi na farko (1, −2), na biyu (0, 1); matrix kishiyar B kuma layi na farko (1, 0), na biyu (−3, 1). Ninkin AB yana da layi na farko (7, 2), na biyu (3, 1). Haeun ta ce “Matrix kishiyar AB ita ce matrix kishiyar A sannan ta B,” Doyun kuma ya ce “Dole ne a ninka matrix kishiyar B sannan matrix kishiyar A.” A kira matrix da aka ƙididdige bisa ƙa’idar Haeun X (layi na farko (7, −2), na biyu (−3, 1)), na Doyun kuma Y (layi na farko (1, −2), na biyu (−3, 7)).
y-m-41-06.thinking.0: Gwada masu yiwuwa ta lissafi, ka kwatanta
y-m-41-06.thinking.1: Bambance abin da misali guda zai iya ƙaryata da abin da ba zai iya yanke hukunci a kai ba
y-m-41-06.thinking.2: Gina hujja ta gama-gari da haruffa
y-m-41-06.s.s1.prompt: Duba ta ninka AB da X da kuma da Y. Wanne ne matrix kishiyar AB?
y-m-41-06.s.s1.hint.0: Lissafa matrix na AB ninkin X da kuma AB ninkin Y.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko sakamakon da ka ƙididdige ya zama matrix na ainihi (layi na farko (1, 0), na biyu (0, 1)).
y-m-41-06.s.s1.o.a: Y kaɗai ce matrix kishiyar AB.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.r.a: Wannan hukunci ne da ya dogara da hujjar ninka wanda ake zargi kai tsaye da dubawa ko ya ba da matrix na ainihi.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.o.b: Duk X da Y matrix kishiyoyin AB ne.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.r.b: Matrix kishiya ita ce matrix da idan an ninka ana samun matrix na ainihi, kuma guda ɗaya ce kawai. Da farko kwatanta ko X da Y matrix iri ɗaya ne.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.o.c: X kaɗai ce matrix kishiyar AB.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.r.c: Idan aka ninka X da AB, sake duba ko ka bincika duk ƙididdigogi huɗu har ƙarshe don ganin ko matrix na ainihi ake samu.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.o.d: X ko Y babu wadda ke matrix kishiyar AB.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.r.d: Idan ɗaya daidai ne amma ka ce babu, wataƙila ƙididdiga ta kauce a wani wuri. Sake lissafa ninkin biyun.
y-m-41-06.s.s1.explain: (AB)Y yana da layi na farko (1, 0) da na biyu (0, 1), saboda haka matrix na ainihi ne, amma (AB)X ba matrix na ainihi ba ne. Don haka a wannan misali matrix kishiyar AB ita ce Y.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.prompt: Me za ka iya cewa daga sakamakon wannan misali guda?
y-m-41-06.s.s2.hint.0: A wannan misali, da farko bincika ko matrix da aka samo bisa ƙa’idar Haeun ya zama matrix kishiya.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.hint.1: Yi tunani ko gaskiyar ƙa’idar Doyun ta yi aiki hujja ce cewa tana aiki ga duk A da B.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.o.a: Ƙa’idar Doyun kullum daidai ce. Domin ta yi daidai a wannan misali.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.r.a: Misali guda da ya yi daidai ba yana nufin daidai ne a kowane yanayi. Ka yi tunani yadda za a bincika ko akwai yanayin da ƙa’idar Doyun za ta iya zama kuskure.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.o.b: Ƙa’idar Haeun ba kullum daidai ba ce. Ko ƙa’idar Doyun kullum daidai ce dole a bincika dabam da haruffa.
y-m-41-06.s.s2.r.b: An bambanta abin da misali guda zai iya ƙaryata da abin da ba zai iya tabbatarwa ba.

y-m-41-08.title: Ninkar da za a iya lissafawa da ninkar da ke da ma’ana
y-m-41-08.topic: Adadin da shigarwar ninkar matrix take wakilta da ma’anar tsarin ninkawa
y-m-41-08.goal: San cewa iya lissafa ninkar matrix ya bambanta da ma’anar shigarwarta, sannan ka tantance tsarin ninkawa ta daidaita ma’anar layuka da shafuka.
y-m-41-08.material: Shaguna biyu (가, 나) suna sayar da burodi da madara. N matrix ce ta yawan tallace-tallace kowace rana; layuka shaguna ne, shafuka kayayyaki. 가 yana sayar da burodi 3 da madara 2, 나 kuma burodi 1 da madara 4, don haka layukan N su ne (3, 2) da (1, 4). Q matrix ce ta farashin kaya guda (won); layuka kayayyaki ne, shafuka yanayi (bazara, hunturu). Burodi 1000 won ne a bazara, 1100 a hunturu; madara 800 da 900. Matrices duka 2×2 ne, don haka NQ da QN ana iya lissafawa. NQ: (4600, 5100), (4200, 4700); QN: (4100, 6400), (3300, 5200). (ƙimomin asali: 1000, 1100, 800, 900)

y-m-41-08.thinking.1: Bambanta ko ana iya lissafa ninkar da ko tana da ma’ana.
y-m-41-08.thinking.2: Faɗa da kalmomi sharadin da ma’anar ke aiki.

y-m-41-08.s.s2.prompt: Shagunan sun yanke sayar da kayan ciye-ciye ma, yanzu kayayyaki 3 ne: burodi, madara, kayan ciye-ciye. N tana da layuka 2 da shafuka 3 (layuka shaguna, shafuka kaya), Q tana da layuka 3 da shafuka 2 (layuka kaya, shafuka yanayi). Wane bayani ya dace?

y-m-41-08.s.s2.o.c: QN tana da layuka 3 da shafuka 3, saboda haka jadawalin tallace-tallace tsakanin kayayyaki ne kuma yana ba da bayani fiye da NQ.

y-m-41-08.s.s2.o.d: Ana iya lissafa NQ da QN, amma NQ kaɗai ce jadawalin tallace-tallace bisa shago da yanayi.
y-m-41-08.s.s2.r.d: Ka yanke hukunci dabam game da ko ana iya lissafa ninkar da ko shigarwarta tana da ma’ana.
y-m-41-08.s.s2.explain: Ninkar N (2×3) da Q (3×2), NQ, tana da girma 2×2; QN kuma 3×3, saboda haka duka ana iya lissafa su. NQ tana ninkawa da tara kayayyaki domin samun tallace-tallace bisa shago da yanayi; QN tana haɗa yanayi da shaguna, saboda haka shigarwarta ba ta da ma’ana.
